title: Delete guard for every session (rm/find -delete/git clean/rmtree only under work/, scratchpad, /tmp), clean-work.sh, auto backup (REQ-0156)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 guard denies unsafe recursive deletes, allows work/ scratchpad /tmp
AC4 auto backup when stale + auto-push

design.summary: PreToolUse delete_guard.py (all sessions): recursive deletes only under work/ and /tmp, protected dirs for plain rm; clean-work.sh; auto backup when stale

implementation.summary: delete_guard.py PreToolUse Bash hook for all sessions (repo-inside and /tmp deletes allowed; repo root/parents/home/, bare root globs, plans/reports/input/results/.git, unresolved recursive targets, git clean -x denied); clean-work.sh; roles + CLAUDE.md rule; post-commit auto backup when stale

unit_test.command: python3 -I tests/unit/test_delete_guard.py; python3 -I tests/unit/test_post_commit_check.py; python3 -I tools/run_tests.py --fast
unit_test.result: delete guard 9 tests (46 deny + 30 allow cases incl. the incident shapes, hook JSON, clean-work.sh escapes) OK; post-commit 11 OK; --fast KNOWN 1 NEW 0

security.result: guard only narrows deletes; fails open on its own bug (logged) except unparseable delete commands; no network; backups stay local (~/exam-harness-backup)

verification.command: live Bash calls in this session with the hook registered; post_commit_check.py --stale-backup; exam backup; autopush.log
verification.result: live: rm under reports/ denied with the reason, rm under work/ ran; stale-backup 1 vs fresh backup, 0 vs empty dir; verified backup 2098 files; commits auto-pushed to origin/feature
